scientific_integrity: General proof by side-preservation and cross-part partial-matching classification, with direct finite exhaustive checks; no independent review claimed.
scientific_limitations: Complete rank and extension-obstruction census for asymmetric complete bipartite graphs only; no extension to arbitrary multipartite or bipartite graphs. A more general unlocated partial-isomorphism enumerator could imply the result. Finite enumeration corroborates rather than proves the all-size claim.
title: Rank spectra and sharp extension cutoff in asymmetric biclique partial-automorphism monoids
